response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(sh.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM sh CROSS JOIN a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The 'average share across all statuses' is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares over every status group, including the NULL group, which equals 1/number of groups.
The summary row averages are taken over only the statuses whose share is above that overall average. avg_share is the mean share of those selected statuses.
A missing status means NULL healtheval, and it forms its own group. Empty strings, if any exist, are treated as a separate group.
